scope: Synthetic schema probes, not business diagnosis or accuracy evaluation. No live business records changed.

strategies.title: No Automated Action and Further Telemetry Investigation
strategies.explanation: Take no automated adapter actions while investigating the absence of operational measurements indicated by evd_schema_probe.
strategies.benefit: Prevents unwarranted changes to live systems when the primary cause is unknown and operational measurements are unavailable.
strategies.downside: If an underlying operational issue exists, it will remain unaddressed until telemetry is restored.
strategies.feasibility: High; requires only human review of monitoring pipelines.
strategies.reversibility: Fully reversible; no system state is altered.
strategies.uncertainty: High regarding underlying business performance due to missing operational data.
advisory: Verify why operational measurements are unavailable in the telemetry pipeline.
Confirm whether the current environment is running a synthetic test fixture or experiencing a data ingestion outage.
strategies.comparison: Recommended because primaryCause is unknown, advisoryOnly is true, and no registered capabilities are available.

strategies.title: Comprehensive Manual Audit Across Storefront, Ads, and Fulfilment
strategies.explanation: Keep automated adapters idle and conduct a manual human audit across all operational domains to establish a baseline while telemetry is offline.
strategies.benefit: Can surface hidden issues across checkout, ad spend, or fulfilment without relying on automated telemetry.
strategies.downside: Consumes higher manual engineering and operations effort when the trigger may only be a synthetic test fixture.
strategies.feasibility: Medium; requires manual coordination across multiple operational teams.
strategies.uncertainty: High; manual checks may be unnecessary if evd_schema_probe simply reflects a routine test probe.
advisory: Manually inspect storefront checkout health and coupon validation logs.
Review active ad campaign spend and fulfilment queues directly in provider dashboards.
Require human approval before initiating any manual configuration changes.
strategies.comparison: Less suitable than targeted telemetry investigation because conducting a full manual operational audit is disproportionate when evidence indicates a synthetic test fixture.

value.recommendation: Recommend strat_no_action_investigate because the diagnosis primary cause is unknown, advisoryOnly is true, and evd_schema_probe indicates a synthetic test fixture with no operational measurements available. Human approval is required for any next steps, and strat_manual_system_audit is less suitable due to unnecessary manual overhead before confirming telemetry status.
